notes.text: The command line can now open a project by its folder path, not just its name: `godothub open <path>`. If the folder is already in GodotHub it opens with its usual version and launch arguments; if it isn't, you can pick a Godot version and optionally add it to GodotHub (#219)
`godothub open` takes --godot <version>, --add and --no-add so it can open a folder without prompting, which makes it easy to wire into a git client or other tool
